title: [build] incorrect debian mirrors when SONIC_VERSION_CONTROL_COMPONENTS and MIRROR_SNAPSHOT were set in rules/config file
author: k-v1
body:
<!--

     You do NOT have to include this information if this is a FEATURE REQUEST

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. git clone sonic-buildimage master branch.
2. `make init`
3. set `SONIC_VERSION_CONTROL_COMPONENTS=all` and  `MIRROR_SNAPSHOT=y` in file rules/config
4. `make configure PLATFORM=vs`
5. compare debian mirror used to build with mirror saved in `/files/build/versions/default/versions-mirror`

#### Describe the results you received:
`http://packages.trafficmanager.net/snapshot/debian/20231105T000251Z` (latest available snapshot on server)

As a result this timestamp is saved to target/versions and used later to build sources.list for dockers and host system.
And I get an error at debootstrap stage:
```
E: Version '1.1.1n-0+deb11u4' for 'libssl1.1' was not found
E: Version '247.3-7+deb11u2' for 'libsystemd0' was not found
E: Version '6.2+20201114-2+deb11u1' for 'libtinfo6' was not found
E: Version '247.3-7+deb11u2' for 'libudev1' was not found
E: Can't find a source to download version '3.118' of 'adduser:amd64'
E: Can't find a source to download version '11.1+deb11u7' of 'base-files:amd64'
E: Can't find a source to download version '1.20.12' of 'dpkg:amd64'
E: Can't find a source to download version '6.2+20201114-2+deb11u1' of 'ncurses-base:amd64'
E: Can't find a source to download version '6.2+20201114-2+deb11u1' of 'ncurses-bin:amd64'
```

#### Describe the results you expected:
`http://packages.trafficmanager.net/snapshot/debian/20230924T000228Z` (snapshot from default/versions-mirror file)

#### Why I did it

Fix #17097 
If I set `SONIC_VERSION_CONTROL_COMPONENTS=all` and `MIRROR_SNAPSHOT=y` in `rules/config` file then I get incorrect sources.list files (with latest available snapshots instead of snapshot from `files/build/versions/default/versions-mirror`).

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

Pass directly make variable `SONIC_VERSION_CONTROL_COMPONENTS` to subshell.

#### How to verify it

Build and check generated sources.list files.

comments.author: k-v1
comments.body:
@xumia
Could you please review/merge this?
It's not critical but it may be not obvivous for users.
If they enable `SONIC_VERSION_CONTROL_COMPONENTS` with `MIRROR_SNAPSHOT` via env variables then all works correctly.
But if they enable these options in rules/config then `SONIC_VERSION_CONTROL_COMPONENTS` is ignored due to this bug.

comments.author: xumia
comments.body:
> @xumia Could you please review/merge this? It's not critical but it may be not obvivous for users. If they enable `SONIC_VERSION_CONTROL_COMPONENTS` with `MIRROR_SNAPSHOT` via env variables then all works correctly. But if they enable these options in rules/config then `SONIC_VERSION_CONTROL_COMPONENTS` is ignored due to this bug.

Thanks for fixing the issue.
